text: I'm sorry this is going to be long, I've been sat here going round in circles. My daughter is 17 months old and she's had a temperature since yesterday afternoon. Tonight it was 38.6 when I checked it about half an hour ago. I gave her Calpol earlier and honestly when it's working she's lovely, playing with her stacking cups, drinking her water and babbling at the dog like normal. Then it wears off and up it goes again and I panic. She's also got a sore throat, she points at it and makes a face when she swallows, but she's still drinking fine, I've been watching every sip. I know it's probably just a bug but she's my first and every time I see that number on the thermometer my heart goes. I just don't know what's normal and what isn't and I'd rather someone told me than lie awake all night checking her.
